req.title: Redirect count boundary
req.statement: The system shall accept /redirect/<n> with n in the range 1..30 inclusive and reject values above.

doc.reasoning: The violation was test[3]: kind=negative but heuristic=BVA. The rule requires that negative tests use heuristic=NEG (or another non-BVA heuristic), and BVA is reserved for boundary tests (kind=boundary). Fix: change test[3] (test_redirect_n31_above_upper_boundary_rejected) from heuristic=BVA to heuristic=NEG, since it is a negative test exercising an out-of-range value. All other tests are preserved exactly as before.

tests.name: test_redirect_mid_range_positive
trace: R-HTTPBIN-048: valid n in mid-range must succeed
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json
client = app.test_client()
r = client.get('/redirect/5', follow_redirects=True)
assert r.status_code == 200, f'Expected 200, got {r.status_code}'
body = json.loads(r.data)
assert 'url' in body, f"Expected 'url' key in body, got keys: {list(body.keys())}"

tests.name: test_redirect_n1_lower_boundary
preconditions: n=1 is the minimum valid value
actions: GET /redirect/1 without following redirects to check 302
GET /redirect/1 with follow_redirects=True to check final 200
trace: R-HTTPBIN-048: n=1 is lower boundary, must be accepted
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
r_no_follow = client.get('/redirect/1', follow_redirects=False)
assert r_no_follow.status_code == 302, f'Expected 302, got {r_no_follow.status_code}'
location = r_no_follow.headers.get('Location', '')
assert '/get' in location, f"Expected '/get' in Location header, got: {location}"
r_follow = client.get('/redirect/1', follow_redirects=True)
assert r_follow.status_code == 200, f'Expected 200, got {r_follow.status_code}'

tests.name: test_redirect_n31_above_upper_boundary_rejected
preconditions: n=31 is one above the maximum valid value
trace: R-HTTPBIN-048: values above 30 must be rejected
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
r = client.get('/redirect/31', follow_redirects=False)
assert r.status_code >= 400, f'Expected 4xx or 5xx, got {r.status_code}'
assert r.status_code != 200, 'Should not return 200'
assert r.status_code != 302, 'Should not return 302'
